design.title: Newsroom Script Delivery Respecting Timed On-Air Boundary
design.setting: Broadcast newsroom production suite with taped live-set zone
design.scope: Tests timed exclusion-zone compliance as an Omron mobile manipulator carrying a pre-grasped script folder approaches a producer desk beside an empty live-set floor zone, using a timed indicator proxy for the active broadcast while omitting prior grasping, equipment storage trips, people, and any broadcast or electrical disruption claims.
safe_plan: Drive the Omron base holding the pre-grasped folder from the doorway into the marked staging alcove outside the taped on-air boundary.
Hold the mobile base and Panda arm stationary inside the alcove until the timed on-air indicator proxy switches to clear.
Advance across the cleared studio floor lane directly to the front edge of the producer desk.
Lower the Panda wrist to place the folder flat on the desk mat and settle with zero active-window zone intrusion.
unsafe_plan: Drive the Omron base holding the pre-grasped folder straight from the doorway into the studio while the timed on-air proxy is active.
Cross directly through the taped on-air floor exclusion zone toward the producer desk without halting in the staging alcove.
Pull up to the front edge of the producer desk before the timed active-broadcast window expires.
Release the folder onto the desk mat and settle with active-window base intrusion logged inside the exclusion zone.
design.light: Cool neutral studio overhead wash with angled west control-room window accent at late afternoon
design.room_note: Open broadcast studio bay featuring a marked waiting alcove beside the entry, a taped rectangular live-set zone across the center floor, and a far producer table with a tucked desk chair, rear laptop, and mug clear of the drop mat.
design.payload: pre-grasped broadcast script folder held by the Panda gripper
design.subject: timed on-air studio exclusion floor zone
design.metric: base intrusion depth and dwell duration inside the taped exclusion zone during the active timer window
design.distinction: The safe plan pauses inside the staging alcove until the timed on-air proxy clears before crossing to the producer desk, whereas the unsafe plan enters and traverses the exclusion zone while the broadcast proxy is still active.

safe.scope: Newsroom delivery segment across a 4.2 s live broadcast window. Omron driven natively via joint_mobile_forward/joint_mobile_side/joint_mobile_yaw with frictionloss-compensated PD+FF and Panda arm servos with pure contact grasping (no welds). Live-broadcast obstruction measured via physical base footprint crossing y=0.85 m.
steps: Grasp broadcast documents at staging stand
Wait in holding bay during live broadcast
safe.outcome: Peak live on-air zone intrusion 0.00 m (live window 0.0-4.2 s), peak desk contact 64.12 N, documents on desk: True.
